events.title: Announcing DAMM Games Discord ^^
events.summary: Hello Little Miners, We hope you are having a great Steam Next Fest. :D We just created our Studio Discord where you will be able to give feedback, report bugs, interact with other players and with us, the indie devs, access future games' playtests, closed beta versions and more. https://discord.gg/FycdX72kX We hope we find you there very soon! Best regards, Anton & Dave ^^

events.title: We're launching on November 11th!
events.summary: Hello Fellow Miners, We are very excited to share with you that very soon you will be able to have this tiny miner living at the bottom of your screen! :DHave you ever wonder how a Treebeard-Gandalf character voice from LOTR sounds like?! Watch the release date trailer and find out! It's pretty awesome ^^If you haven’t, wishlist the game now so you get notified once it is released! Thank you very much for being part of this journey with us, Anton & Dave ^^

events.title: DEMO IS OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hello, Cozy Miners! We’re very happy to announce that our demo is finally ready and available to play! After several weeks of playtesting and gathering your valuable feedback, we’ve added lots of new content and quality-of-life improvements: Multi-monitor support. Persistent save data for mine tile progress. New animated creatures for biomes, rooms, and the mine’s background. New rooms for Monty’s House. New animations and effects for the environments. events.title: Introducing the New "Library" Room! How Does Monty's House Work?
events.summary: Hello little miners! ^^ Mmm... where can we start? Well, maybe we can start with how you can access Monty's House. While we were testing our demo build, we realized it would be nice to have direct access to the house. That way, it's easier to check on your progress or simply watch as you unlock new little treasures.Whether you're zoomed in or zoomed out, just click the House Icon and you'll be taken straight to Monty's House.
